Without this file a Portuguese record returns fixture_not_found and the model falls back to untested training knowledge on the one point most likely to be got backwards. # Portugal Naming Customs

## Surnames

* Where children received both parents' surnames, **the mother's surname would typically precede the father's surname**. This is the reverse of the Spanish order.
* From the mid-20th century onward, individuals tended to include their last (father's) surname in formal settings.

## Women's surnames at marriage

* Women tended to retain their maiden surname throughout their life.
* In the late 19th century it became common for women to adopt their husband's surname, but this practice faded by the end of the century.

## Emigration

* Most of the time the surname spelling changed to accommodate the different phonetic spelling in the English language.
* Different branches of the same family may adopt various surname spellings.
